Create a software inventory and keep it up to date, the following categories:

Describe externals from the pre-existing spack build in a table:

Software that was written by the agents and added to nodd, flag a PR if exists
- to run within the ActsExamples

For each component, write keywords for the main usage

For each component, tell how it is integrated (submodule, local installation, source added to nodd)

Make a page accessible from the main page to do so.
Make sure it is always updated when a new software piece is added.
